entries.proposition: PRIMATE DORSAL ROOT GANGLION HISTOPATHOLOGY HAS ALREADY FUNCTIONED AS A PROGRAMME-STOPPING REGULATORY SIGNAL FOR A HUMAN PAEDIATRIC INTRATHECAL PROGRAMME USING THIS CAPSID AND ROUTE.
entries.snippet: Concerns for DRG toxicity identified in NHPs by other investigators81 prompted the FDA to issue a hold on further enrolment.

entries.proposition: HUMAN DORSAL ROOT GANGLION TOXICITY ON THIS ROUTE HAS APPEARED, AND WHERE IT APPEARED IT WAS SENSORY, MILD AND RESPONSIVE TO SYMPTOMATIC TREATMENT RATHER THAN PROGRESSIVE.
entries.snippet: Hepatotoxicity resolved by the end of the follow-up period 1 while symptoms related to DRG toxicity improved with symptomatic treatment.
entries.anchor: Clinical applications, 'Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA)', STEER paragraph

entries.proposition: AT THE HIGHEST INTRATHECAL DOSES REPORTED IN HUMANS, DORSAL ROOT GANGLION INTEGRITY WAS ASSESSED BY PATIENT-MEASURABLE MODALITIES AND NO SIGNAL WAS FOUND, WHICH ARGUES AGAINST A SIMPLE MONOTONIC DOSE-DRIVEN MECHANISM IN HUMANS.
entries.snippet: Notably there were no signs of DRG toxicity when assessed by MRI and peripheral nerve conduction studies.

entries.proposition: THE SAME NEGATIVE WAS OBTAINED BY CLINICAL AND ELECTROPHYSIOLOGICAL ASSESSMENT IN A SEPARATE SINGLE-PATIENT PROGRAMME DOSED AT THE TOP OF THE HUMAN INTRATHECAL RANGE.
entries.snippet: There was no clinical or electrophysiologic evidence of DRG toxicity: no neuropathic pain, and normal sensory exams and nerve conduction studies.

entries.proposition: WHERE THE RECIPIENT IS PREDICTED TO HAVE NO ENDOGENOUS EXPRESSION OF THE TRANSGENE PRODUCT, PROGRAMMES ADOPT TRIPLE IMMUNOSUPPRESSION RATHER THAN A STEROID ALONE. A BIALLELIC LOSS-OF-FUNCTION RECIPIENT FALLS IN THAT CLASS BY CONSTRUCTION.
entries.snippet: An immunosuppression regimen modelled from the GAN trial (prednisolone, sirolimus, and tacrolimus) was used to mitigate immune responses and promote tolerance to AP4M1, given the predicted absence of endogenous expression for this patient.

entries.proposition: THE SAME LOGIC IS STATED AS AN ENROLMENT RATIONALE IN THE PROGRAMME THE OTHERS WERE MODELLED ON, LINKING ABSENT ENDOGENOUS PROTEIN TO ANTI-TRANSGENE IMMUNE RISK.
entries.snippet: The cohort included individuals predicted to have no residual gigaxonin expression (CRIM-negative) and thus at higher risk of developing an immune response to transgene-expressed gigaxonin protein, as well as participants who were AAV9-seropositive (neutralising antibody titre ≥1:5) or seronegative at baseline.

entries.proposition: THE REVIEW'S OWN MECHANISTIC POSITION IS THAT THE TOXICITY IS DRIVEN BY EXPRESSION LEVEL UNDER STRONG UBIQUITOUS PROMOTERS, AND ITS PROPOSED MITIGATION IS A WEAKER OR CELL-RESTRICTED PROMOTER.
entries.snippet: One of the main concerns that have to be addressed in future studies is the DRG toxicity mostly related to supraphysiological gene expression levels with strong ubiquitous promoters.

entries.proposition: THE NEAREST HUMAN DISEASE PRECEDENT IN THIS SOURCE IS A PAEDIATRIC NEURODEGENERATIVE SEIZURE-BEARING DISORDER DOSED BY THE SAME ROUTE AND CAPSID UNDER TRIPLE IMMUNOSUPPRESSION, WITH AN UNCONTROLLED HISTORICAL COMPARISON AS ITS ONLY EFFICACY EVIDENCE.
entries.snippet: While the disease progressed in all subjects (6–8 years old at the time of publication), the >2 years long-term follow up suggested a deviation from the natural history of the disease including maintenance of respiratory function, maintenance of oral feeding, and relative stability in their seizures.
